Therefore, the Router was correct to mark it false, but the reasoning should emphasize the lack of physical plausibility rather than just visibility. alignment_reasoning: The image fails significantly on functional alignment. While the geometric silhouette (green rectangles on a pole) matches the 'street sign' class visually, the core functional component—legible text—is completely absent (gibberish). The `fine_grained_classifier` correctly identifies the class based on shape/color priors, but this masks the semantic failure. Only 4 out of 8 testable checkpoints passed (Geometry, Contrast, Material, Color Scheme). The failure of text legibility and standardized typography constitutes a major deviation from the taxonomy definition of a 'street sign' as an informational panel.
